description: Source code for TinyMCE Flash plugin, defining plugin info, initialization, control HTML, command execution, content cleanup, and node change handling.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information including name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes plugin instance, optionally importing CSS.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for plugin controls, specifically the flash button.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes commands like inserting or updating flash objects in the editor.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up content by converting embedded flash objects to placeholder images and vice versa.

methods.name: handleNodeChange
methods.description: Handles node change events to update button states based on selection.

methods.name: _parseAttributes
methods.description: Parses HTML attribute strings into key-value pairs.
